nodes.label: Copilot instructions for volt
nodes.rationale: Agent-facing build, architecture, and docs-sync rules for the Volt workspace.

nodes.label: Claude graphify and agent-skill notes
nodes.rationale: Short Claude entry pointing at the graphify graph and the docs-sync subagent.

nodes.label: Volt domain language
nodes.rationale: Shared product language for core crates and user packages, including terms to avoid.

nodes.label: Volt README
nodes.rationale: Project overview, workspace layout, local builds, Nix shell, and current editor status.

nodes.label: Commit Volt Docs skill
nodes.rationale: Commit docs inside the volt-docs submodule first, then bump the parent gitlink.

nodes.label: Update Volt Docs skill
nodes.rationale: Sync volt-docs to a Volt product change on a fresh subagent; do not commit in this skill.

nodes.label: oh-my-githubcopilot instructions
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent orchestration layer for GitHub Copilot, separate from Volt product agent skills.

nodes.label: Volt Docs site README
nodes.rationale: VitePress help site with client-side TF-IDF search and no AI embeddings or backend.

nodes.label: Create Volt Docs skill
nodes.rationale: Author new help pages from Volt source so in-editor help search can land on them.

nodes.label: Refresh Volt Docs skill
nodes.rationale: Resync existing Markdown from the Volt tree, rebuild the search index, and check help queries.

nodes.label: user crate README
nodes.rationale: Compiled customization layer; YAML runtime config is picked up without a rebuild.

nodes.label: Master user config
nodes.rationale: Reference file, not a YAML include: Volt reads the master, then loads each child at runtime.

nodes.label: cargo xtask ci
nodes.rationale: Full validation path used by CI: fmt-check, check, clippy -D warnings, and tests.

nodes.label: EditorRuntime
nodes.rationale: Central runtime bundling the model plus service, command, hook, and keymap registries.

nodes.label: EditorModel
nodes.rationale: Model shape is Window, then Workspace, then Pane or Popup, then Buffer.

nodes.label: volt executable
nodes.rationale: Thin entry point. Default path launches editor_sdl::run_demo_shell.

nodes.label: user/sdk plugin ABI
nodes.rationale: Only stable plugin ABI crate; abi_stable types shared across the host/user boundary.

nodes.label: editor-plugin-host
nodes.rationale: Translates PluginPackage metadata into runtime commands, hooks, and keybindings.

nodes.label: user crate
nodes.rationale: Compiled customization layer exporting packages, syntax languages, themes, language servers, and debug adapters.

nodes.label: editor-sdl
nodes.rationale: Builds its own EditorRuntime and stores shell UI state in runtime services. SDL_ttf uses no-sdlttf-harfbuzz to avoid Windows linker problems.

nodes.label: editor-buffer
nodes.rationale: Rope-backed text editing.

nodes.label: editor-fs
nodes.rationale: Workspace discovery and directory buffers.

nodes.label: editor-syntax
nodes.rationale: Tree-sitter registration, install, and loading.

nodes.label: editor-theme
nodes.rationale: Token resolution.

nodes.label: editor-jobs
nodes.rationale: External command execution.

nodes.label: editor-terminal
nodes.rationale: External command execution.

nodes.label: editor-lsp
nodes.rationale: Language server session planning.

nodes.label: editor-dap
nodes.rationale: Debug adapter session planning.

nodes.label: user::packages
nodes.rationale: Source of compiled-in packages. auto_load false packages such as git are compiled in but not activated on boot.

nodes.label: PluginPackage
nodes.rationale: Declarative commands use PluginAction LogMessage, OpenBuffer, or EmitHook, plus optional hook declaration and binding.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Lives at graphify-out/. Architecture questions should read GRAPH_REPORT.md before scanning files. graphify update . refreshes AST-only.

nodes.label: docs sync subagent
nodes.rationale: After user-facing product changes, spawn a fresh subagent. Do not update or commit docs on the main thread.

nodes.label: volt-docs submodule
nodes.rationale: docs/ is the VitePress help site submodule.

nodes.label: GitHub issue tracker
nodes.rationale: Issues live in GitHub Issues for samwdp/volt via gh.

nodes.label: triage role labels
nodes.rationale: Canonical names: needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, wontfix.

nodes.label: --shell-hidden
nodes.rationale: One-frame hidden SDL smoke test. On Linux it still needs a display because startup builds the WebKitGTK browser host.

nodes.label: --bootstrap-demo
nodes.rationale: Non-UI bootstrap: builds EditorRuntime, loads user packages, installs LSP, DAP, syntax, and theme registries.

nodes.label: VOLT_GRAMMAR_DIR
nodes.rationale: Overrides the per-user grammar directory. Default is %LOCALAPPDATA%\volt\grammars or the XDG/local share path.

nodes.label: workspace discovery roots
nodes.rationale: Agents.md says search roots are configured in user/workspace.rs as P:\ and W:\ with max depth 4.

nodes.label: Rust stable >= 1.91
nodes.rationale: Edition 2024. Cloud snapshot expects a recent stable toolchain.

nodes.label: domain docs
nodes.rationale: Single context is root CONTEXT.md plus docs/adr/.

nodes.label: Workspace
nodes.rationale: An open editing context in a Window: a name, optional project root, and its panes and buffers.

nodes.label: Default Workspace
nodes.rationale: Scratch Workspace with no project root for boot and scratch editing. Not part of project cycling and cannot be Marked.

nodes.label: Project Workspace
nodes.rationale: A Workspace that has a project root path. Next/previous cycling and Marks apply only to these.

nodes.label: Mark List
nodes.rationale: Ordered app-wide list of project root paths. Canonical store is a plain-text file of one path per line.

nodes.label: Marked Workspace
nodes.rationale: A project root recorded in the Mark List. Only the first four entries have dedicated key bindings.

nodes.label: Minor Mode
nodes.rationale: A keybinding layer that overrides Global bindings while active. Global bindings are the fallback.

nodes.label: Multicursor Mode
nodes.rationale: Minor Mode while linked multicursors exist. Started by g n / g N; cleared on Normal-mode exit.

nodes.label: Popup
nodes.rationale: Horizontal overlay for pickers, Command Stream, terminal, and similar buffers. Distinct from Workspace Dock.

nodes.label: Workspace Dock
nodes.rationale: Vertical list of open Workspaces. While focused it is its own Minor Mode so j/k cycle Workspaces.

nodes.label: ACP Dock
nodes.rationale: Vertical list of ACP buffers for the active Workspace, always on the right edge. Enter with Ctrl+l; leave with Ctrl+h.

nodes.label: Worktree
nodes.rationale: A git worktree checkout path that can be opened as a Project Workspace root.

nodes.label: Bare Repo
nodes.rationale: Git bare clone used as the shared object store for Worktrees. Not the day-to-day Project Workspace root.

nodes.label: Workspace Clone
nodes.rationale: Flow started by workspace.clone: remote URL, bare or full clone, oil parent, Command Stream, then dashboard or Project Workspace.

nodes.label: Drive List
nodes.rationale: Virtual oil listing of Windows logical drives, parent of a drive root via oil open-parent. Not used on non-Windows hosts.

nodes.label: Workspace Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Picker of Worktrees for the active context. Opened by workspace.dashboard or leader p d.

nodes.label: Worktree Remove
nodes.rationale: Force-removes a Worktree from disk after closing every open Project Workspace on that path. Does not change the Mark List or delete the branch.

nodes.label: Picker Extra Keybind
nodes.rationale: Chord-to-command binding on one picker instance, layered above shared picker Popup bindings. Firing it closes the picker.

nodes.label: User Library
nodes.rationale: Shared library Volt loads at startup (user.dll / libuser.so / libuser.dylib) holding compiled customization.

nodes.label: User Source Tree
nodes.rationale: Staged copy of User Library sources shipped with a release (user/ under the profile dir) so the library can be rebuilt without the full Volt repository.

nodes.label: Volt API
nodes.rationale: nvim-style function table (volt::buf, volt::lsp, volt::ui, volt::hook). New host capabilities extend this table because UserLibraryModule is at the ABI prefix-field limit.

nodes.label: Plugin Package
nodes.rationale: One extension unit of PluginPackage metadata. Lives as a module under User Library sources, for example user/calculator.rs.

nodes.label: Builtin Plugin
nodes.rationale: A Plugin Package that ships inside the User Library. Users may edit and rebuild it; it is not a separate install.

nodes.label: Plugin SDK
nodes.rationale: Stable authoring crate user/sdk, package name editor-plugin-api. A leaf with no path deps on other Volt crates so users need no Volt git checkout.

nodes.label: Issue
nodes.rationale: Tracked unit of work whose canonical record is a markdown file in the Issue Store.

nodes.label: Code Reference
nodes.rationale: A source comment pointing at an Issue. Linked form is TODO(ISS-NNN): or FIXME(ISS-NNN):. Unlinked TODO/FIXME may be Captured.

nodes.label: Issue Id
nodes.rationale: Stable sequential identifier spoken as ISS-NNN, independent of title or file path.

nodes.label: Issue Store
nodes.rationale: Workspace-root directory issues/. Project truth for Issues, distinct from agent scratch under .scratch/.

nodes.label: Issue Status
nodes.rationale: Recorded only on the Issue markdown. Statuses are Open, Planning, In Progress, and Closed. Any status may be set from any other.

nodes.label: Capture
nodes.rationale: Turns a comment with no Issue Id into an Issue plus a Code Reference. Must not block the user waiting on save or scan completion.

nodes.label: Create
nodes.rationale: Minting an Issue from a command and title, with no Code Reference required.

nodes.label: Issue Scan
nodes.rationale: Workspace-wide pass that Captures unlinked comments and refreshes Code Reference links. Drops stale locations but never deletes the Issue.

nodes.label: Issue Board
nodes.rationale: Generated workspace buffer listing Issues. A view, not the store. Closed Issues are hidden unless requested.

nodes.label: Place
nodes.rationale: Inserts a Code Reference for an Issue at the cursor and records that location on the Issue.

nodes.label: External Command
nodes.rationale: A process the editor spawns outside its own address space, distinct from an internal editor command id.

nodes.label: Owned Process
nodes.rationale: Process-tree root Volt started and must terminate as a unit (Windows Job Object or Unix process group).

nodes.label: Process Registry
nodes.rationale: App-wide index of Owned Processes, each with an OwnedProcessId and zero or more Workspace tags.

nodes.label: Share Key
nodes.rationale: Identity when one Owned Process serves multiple Workspaces. The process dies when the last Workspace tag is removed.

nodes.label: Process Launch
nodes.rationale: The sole allowed way Volt starts an Owned Process; every OS spawn goes through it into the Process Registry.

nodes.label: Workspace Close
nodes.rationale: Teardown for one Workspace: graceful-then-force against Owned Processes tagged with that Workspace.

nodes.label: Application Quit
nodes.rationale: One global graceful-then-force against the entire Process Registry, not a loop of Workspace Closes.

nodes.label: Command Stream
nodes.rationale: Live stdout/stderr of an External Command written into a popup buffer. Default presentation for long, network, or progress commands.

nodes.label: Silent Command
nodes.rationale: External Command run to completion with no Command Stream popup. Used for silent prep and fast local mutators.

nodes.label: Git Editor Buffer
nodes.rationale: Editable pane buffer standing in for GIT_EDITOR. Distinct from the dedicated commit message buffer, which never uses GIT_EDITOR.

nodes.label: Language Server
nodes.rationale: External language-server program named by a Language Server Spec. Distinct from a Language Server Session.

nodes.label: Volt Data Directory
nodes.rationale: Per-user directory with sibling grammars/, lsp/, and dap/ folders. Overriding the grammar directory does not move lsp or dap.

nodes.label: Install Recipe
nodes.rationale: Typed method on a Language Server or Debug Adapter Spec: npm, dotnet tool, Go, pip, cargo, or an archive download. Not an arbitrary shell command. Re-running upgrades.

nodes.label: Install Picker
nodes.rationale: Opened by lsp.install-server or dap.install-server. Rows show whether Volt can already start the program.

nodes.label: Language Server Install
nodes.rationale: Volt-owned copy used when the program is not on PATH. Not added to the user shell PATH. Volt installs the server, not the language toolchain.

nodes.label: Solution
nodes.rationale: A .sln grouping C# projects. When present, csharp-ls uses one Language Server Session for that Solution.

nodes.label: Language Server Session
nodes.rationale: One planned or live language-server process for a given server and root.

nodes.label: Language Server Session Stop
nodes.rationale: lsp.stop shuts down one live Session for the whole app, not only the active buffer.

nodes.label: Language Server Session Restart
nodes.rationale: lsp.restart restarts one live Session in the active Workspace.

nodes.label: Debug Adapter
nodes.rationale: External Debug Adapter Protocol process used for a Debug Session. PATH-visible adapter is preferred.

nodes.label: Debug Adapter Install
nodes.rationale: Volt-owned adapter copy when the program is not on PATH. An explicit install does not start a Debug Session because DAP has no file-open auto-start.

nodes.label: Debug Session
nodes.rationale: At most one live debug connection owned by a Workspace. Leaving the Workspace tears down Debug Layout but keeps the Session alive.

nodes.label: Debug Configuration
nodes.rationale: Named launch or attach setup from compiled defaults, optional project files, inference, and picker fills.

nodes.label: Debug Layout
nodes.rationale: System-owned three-pane split: Breakpoints, editor, and Locals. User splits are blocked while it is active. REPL and pickers use Popup.

nodes.label: Debug Stop
nodes.rationale: Single command that ends the active Workspace Debug Session. Launch terminates the debugee; attach leaves the process running. There is no separate detach command.

nodes.label: Breakpoint
nodes.rationale: Line marker stored for a Workspace that can be toggled without a live Debug Session and is synced when a Session starts.

nodes.label: Watch Expression
nodes.rationale: User-owned expression re-evaluated while the Debug Session is stopped.

nodes.label: Debug Fringe
nodes.rationale: While a Debug Session is live, the gutter widens so DAP markers sit beside git fringe marks.

nodes.label: DAP Mode
nodes.rationale: Minor Mode while the active Workspace has a live Debug Session, so continue/step chords override Global start bindings.

nodes.label: Markdown Pretty
nodes.rationale: Beautified on-screen markdown while the buffer text stays canonical markdown source.

nodes.label: Markdown Raw
nodes.rationale: Canonical markdown source with Pretty chrome suppressed.

nodes.label: Anti-conceal
nodes.rationale: Temporarily shows Markdown Raw for the cursor line and Visual selection so navigation and yank use real source text.

nodes.label: Forced Language
nodes.rationale: Sticky language id not inferred from path, so non-file buffers such as ACP output can be treated as markdown.

nodes.label: Markdown Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Single presentation path from markdown source to highlight plus Pretty, shared by file buffers, hover, and ACP payloads.

nodes.label: Pretty Kill-switch
nodes.rationale: Optional size threshold that disables Markdown Pretty for oversized source. Default off.

nodes.label: Database Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Plugin buffer db.dashboard: Connections and Tables on the left, Editor and Output on the right.

nodes.label: Database Multiview
nodes.rationale: Split opened by db.multiview. Golden-ratio sizing is forced off. Query output stays a popup.

nodes.label: Buffer Section Layout
nodes.rationale: Named split tree on plugin buffer sections. Absent a layout, sections stack vertically.

nodes.label: editor-render
nodes.rationale: Rendering abstractions and viewport drawing.

nodes.label: editor-ui
nodes.rationale: Shared chrome widgets used by the SDL shell.

nodes.label: editor-git
nodes.rationale: Magit-style git workflows.

nodes.label: editor-picker
nodes.rationale: Fuzzy picker and list UI abstractions.

nodes.label: xtask
nodes.rationale: Developer automation: fmt, fmt-check, check, clippy, test, and ci.

nodes.label: volt-user
nodes.rationale: Crate that builds the user shared library as rlib and cdylib. Install users rebuild it from the shipped user/ tree, not from the Volt git checkout.

nodes.label: workspace.compile
nodes.rationale: Prefills cargo build --release -p volt-user. On success Volt stages a unique copy under user/target/<profile>/volt-user-hot/ and hot-reloads it, because a loaded DLL stays locked on Windows.

nodes.label: VOLT_USER_LIBRARY
nodes.rationale: Points the binary at a specific user shared library path.

nodes.label: user/.cargo/config.toml target dir guard
nodes.rationale: Staged tree forces Cargo to use user/target/ so a parent CARGO_TARGET_DIR cannot truncate a live mapped user.dll to zero bytes.

nodes.label: Nix flake dev shell
nodes.rationale: Linux/WSL2 dev shell only. Does not package a release binary. Targets x86_64-linux and aarch64-linux.

nodes.label: Linux native dependencies
nodes.rationale: SDL/browser builds need GTK3 and WebKitGTK 4.1, the same packages as CI and the release workflow.

nodes.label: SDL shell launch commands
nodes.rationale: cargo run -p volt, plus --shell-demo, --shell-hidden, --profile-typing, and --bootstrap-demo.

nodes.label: --profile-typing
nodes.rationale: Keeps per-frame input timing samples and writes a typing profile log on exit.

nodes.label: default shell keybindings
nodes.rationale: Vim from user/vim.rs; F3 command picker; F4 buffer picker; F5 docked popup; F6 keybinding picker; F7 theme picker.

nodes.label: bundled icon fonts
nodes.rationale: Loaded at startup from crates/volt/assets/font. Berkeley Mono Nerd Font is preferred when installed.

nodes.label: docs submodule then parent gitlink
nodes.rationale: Commit only documentation under docs/ and the parent docs gitlink. Do not push, amend, force-push, or update git config unless asked.

nodes.label: docs drift inventory
nodes.rationale: Default scope is drift-only. Source of truth is the Volt tree, not old HTML. Hand off to commit-volt-docs without committing here.

nodes.label: help page layout
nodes.rationale: Plugins, guides, user-packages, and languages each have a docs path. Frontmatter title and description are search-weighted.

nodes.label: Help query line
nodes.rationale: Pages lead with natural-language questions because in-editor help opens /volt-docs/search.

nodes.label: refresh inventory
nodes.rationale: Compares user/lib.rs packages() and user/themes to docs pages, then reindexes and checks sample help queries.

nodes.label: user-package workflow template
nodes.rationale: Emphasizes cargo build -p volt-user, workspace.compile, and registration in user/lib.rs packages().

nodes.label: client-side TF-IDF search
nodes.rationale: Index is generated at build time into docs/public/search-index.json and is not hand-edited. Field weights favor title over body and code.

nodes.label: in-editor help command
nodes.rationale: help opens https://samwdp.github.io/volt-docs/search?q= with the user question.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages deploy
nodes.rationale: On push to main, npm run build uploads docs/.vitepress/dist and deploys to the github-pages environment.

nodes.label: oh-my-githubcopilot
nodes.rationale: Delegates specialized work to named agents and slash-command skills. State files live under .omc/.

nodes.label: vscode_askQuestions hooks
nodes.rationale: Pauses skill workflows for structured user decisions instead of plain chat questions.

nodes.label: OMG commit trailers
nodes.rationale: Conventional commits may carry Constraint, Rejected, Directive, Confidence, Scope-risk, and Not-tested trailers.

nodes.label: CI
nodes.rationale: On push to main or master and on pull_request. Job rust runs cargo xtask ci on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS with fail-fast false.

nodes.label: CI Linux system dependencies
nodes.rationale: Linux runners install GTK3, WebKitGTK 4.1, and the SDL/audio/X11/GL development packages.

nodes.label: CI build-release job
nodes.rationale: Builds cargo build -p volt --release --locked on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS. Does not build volt-user.

nodes.label: tag release
nodes.rationale: Runs on v* tags with contents: write. Publishes a GitHub Release from per-OS zip artifacts.

nodes.label: release zip bundle
nodes.rationale: Each OS zip contains the volt binary, the user shared library, assets/, and a copied user/ tree.

nodes.label: staged User Source Tree build
nodes.rationale: After staging, cargo build --release -p volt-user runs inside target/release/user to prove the shipped tree rebuilds.

nodes.label: Lucide dock icons
nodes.rationale: buffer.svg from app-window, tab.svg from panels-top-left, bookmark.svg from bookmark. Stroke recolored to #FFFFFF for dock rasterization.

nodes.label: volt-user shared library
nodes.rationale: Built library is named user: user.dll, libuser.so, or libuser.dylib.

nodes.label: phase-1 runtime config
nodes.rationale: YAML changes for search roots, ACP clients, picker truncation, terminal defaults, ligatures, pane layout, and oil are picked up while Volt is running.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_THEME_ID
nodes.rationale: user/theme.rs keeps the default theme first. Current id is volt-arc.

nodes.label: bundled theme ids
nodes.rationale: volt-arc, gruvbox-dark, gruvbox-light, rosepine-dark, volt-dark, volt-light, vscode-dark, vscode-light.

nodes.label: themes/global.toml
nodes.rationale: Shared UI options and language defaults live here so they are not repeated in every theme file.

nodes.label: theme picker chord
nodes.rationale: user/README.md says the default keymap opens the theme picker with F6.

nodes.label: ACP clients
nodes.rationale: agent (agent acp --yolo), codex (codex-acp), copilot (copilot --acp --stdio --yolo), opencode (opencode acp), and pi (node).

nodes.label: oil defaults
nodes.rationale: show_hidden false, sort_mode type-then-name, trash_enabled false.

nodes.label: oil keybindings
nodes.rationale: Includes open_parent on hyphen, prefix g, and create_git_worktree on wn.

nodes.label: picker and paren options
nodes.rationale: picker_truncate_strategy auto; ligatures, rainbow parens, and show paren enabled.

nodes.label: pane.golden_ratio
nodes.rationale: golden_ratio is true.

nodes.label: workspace_dock config
nodes.rationale: side left, docked false.

nodes.label: keymap.ambiguous_prefix_timeout_ms
nodes.rationale: Timeout is 250 ms.

nodes.label: project_search_roots
nodes.rationale: P:\, W:\, and C:\Users\sam\, each with max_depth 4. Missing paths are filtered out.

hyperedges.label: Master config.yaml points at four runtime child files
Product change docs sync uses update, authoring skills, then commit
Release zip ships binary, user library, assets, and User Source Tree
